description: Find the Federal Judicial Center (FJC) Integrated Database numeric code for a federal district court or circuit by name, e.g. "Eastern District of Texas" returns district code 40, "Fifth Circuit" returns circuit code 5. Accepts a full name, a Bluebook form ("E.D. Tex."), a PACER-style short form ("txed") or a state name (returns every district in that state); give kind "district", "circuit" or "all" with no query to list every court of that kind (94 districts, 12 circuits). An unrecognised name returns the nearest matches, never an empty result. The codes are the ones the other FJC tools take as district_or_circuit (they also accept names directly). Source: FJC Integrated Database codebooks. Keyless.

kind.description: Restrict to district courts or circuits; with no query, "all" lists every court.

query.description: Court name, abbreviation, state or code, e.g. "Eastern District of Texas", "E.D. Tex.", "Texas", "Ninth Circuit". Omit it and pass kind to list courts.

name: fjc_court_codes

error.description: Set when neither query nor kind was given

note.description: Set when the result is the nearest matches

query.description: The query asked, null when listing

title: Fjc Court Codes
